name: MELTRI∀
source:
When I awoke, I found myself in the familiar world of social media...

Caught between ideal and reality—this is the slightly strange, somewhat twisted, heart-warming tale of two boys who wandered into MELTRI∀.

[Edited/translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12935]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
醒来之时，眼前已是那片无比熟悉的社交媒体世界……

夹在理想与现实的缝隙之间——这是一段由误入MELTRI∀的两名少年所谱写的，略显奇妙、有些扭曲却又温暖人心的故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12935]Novelgame[/url]（经编辑）]
